title: Musical family, library home and rowboat rehearsals
summary: His mother and grandmother taught piano but did not encourage him; raised in a Carnegie Library, he practiced cornet, banjo and mandolin along the river, self-taught.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
